document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: AGENT-START-01..03及05在设计层已关闭；仍需明确可编译的 TeacherAgent 精确 T-01 渲染 API/黄金文本语义，以及 rollback 后同一 task 的共享预算处理。

findings.title: T-01 precise render contract is not a callable TeacherAgent API
findings.evidence: SDD invokes RenderID(OP-1), which exists on scripts.Bank rather than exported TeacherAgent; api adapter cannot access TeacherAgent.bank. Existing TeacherAgent.Render performs category selection; Bank.RenderID still colloquializes and changes nickname, so the exact golden string is not clearly the runtime output contract. Fallback ownership is also unclear.
findings.required_change: Specify a compileable Agent-layer T01 renderer and its input/output/template/fallback semantics; define whether OP-1 may colloquialize and whether golden is byte-exact or semantic. Keep script bank access and teaching copy inside Agent layer. Add semantic and length assertions.

findings.title: Same event retry can refresh the two-call tool budget
findings.evidence: SDD gives each context budget=2 and permits same-command pure tool re-execution after proven rollback. Existing tools.WithEventBudget stores counter in context; rebuilding context resets it, while reusing it leaves no budget after say+show_word. Resetting would violate docs/04 shared per-event budget.
findings.required_change: Freeze same-task budget behavior across rollback/retry. Do not create a new task/context just to obtain fresh budget. Define recovery (persistent budget, precomputed audited plan, or terminal failure) and test first-call rollback/retry accounting.
